Composition under Variants of Differential Privacy

children.label: Composition under Variants of Differential Privacy

children.value: Which variant should we use, and when?
tighter bounds on privacy cost when:
The Gaussian mechanism is used (especially on high-dimensional vectors)
The algorithm in question applies the mechanism many times (e.g. hundreds or thousands of times)
To use RDP and zCDP, we typically implement an algorithm in terms of the variant we want to use, and then convert the total privacy cost of running the algorithm back to
